text:
Full Action-Scene Script: Animation vs. Geometry

Scene 1 — Dark Introduction

A completely black vertical frame appears.

A thin white horizontal line slowly draws across the lower part of the screen, establishing the ground.

At the top, the title fades in:

ANIMATION VS. GEOMETRY

Below it:

A Proof Motion Experiment

The title glows softly, then becomes less prominent as the action begins.

⸻

Scene 2 — The Orange Character Appears

A small orange stick figure drops into the scene from the upper-left.

It lands on the white ground line in a crouched position.

A short orange impact glow appears beneath its feet.

The character slowly raises its head, looks around, and stands.

Its body has subtle idle movement:

* slight breathing
* small head motion
* relaxed arm movement

The character notices something forming on the right side of the frame.

⸻

Scene 3 — The Geometry Orb Forms

Several white points appear in empty space on the right.

Thin white lines begin connecting the points.

More lines are added until they form a dense wireframe orb made of intersecting chords and polygonal structures.

The orb rotates slowly.

Small white particles flicker around it.

The orange character leans backward slightly, surprised and cautious.

The orb produces a faint pulse, as though it has become aware of the character.

⸻

Scene 4 — First Contact

The orange figure takes a few careful steps toward the orb.

The orb remains still but continues rotating.

A glowing mathematical symbol appears on the ground between them:

\phi

The figure crouches and examines the symbol.

It touches the symbol with one hand.

The symbol pulses brightly.

The orb suddenly shakes.

Several of its internal lines rearrange.

The character immediately pulls its hand away.

⸻

Scene 5 — The Orb Attacks

The wireframe orb rapidly expands.

Its rotation becomes faster and more unstable.

White particles shoot outward.

The orb moves toward the character.

The orange figure freezes for a fraction of a second, then enters a deep acceleration pose:

* torso leaning sharply forward
* head ahead of the shoulders
* one knee lifted
* support leg pushing backward
* arms bent tightly

The figure launches into a sprint.

⸻

Scene 6 — The Running Shot

The character runs from left to right.

The running cycle contains clear poses:

1. front-foot contact
2. compressed landing
3. high-knee passing pose
4. strong push-off
5. airborne stride
6. opposite-foot contact

The character’s speed increases with each cycle.

The torso leans farther forward.

The stride becomes longer.

The arms swing opposite to the legs.

A short orange motion trail appears behind the runner.

The white orb follows closely, growing larger in the frame.

The camera tracks both objects from the side.

⸻

Scene 7 — Geometry Changes the Ground

The orb fires a thin white line ahead of the runner.

The flat ground line bends upward and becomes a diagonal ramp.

Small coordinate marks and geometric points appear along the ramp.

The runner has no time to stop.

It reaches the slope, tries to maintain balance, and begins climbing it.

The orb continues approaching from behind.

The ramp suddenly rotates.

The character loses contact with the surface.

⸻

Scene 8 — Launch and Impact

The character is launched into the air.

Its body rotates horizontally.

The arms and legs spread from the force.

A bright white geometric plane appears in front of it.

The figure collides with the plane.

At the moment of impact:

* the screen flashes white
* orange and white particles burst outward
* the camera shakes briefly
* the figure freezes for a split second
* a circular shockwave expands from the contact point

The figure then falls downward.

⸻

Scene 9 — The Golden-Ratio World

As the character falls, the black space transforms into a large rectangular geometric construction.

A main rectangle appears.

It subdivides into successively smaller squares.

Each square is proportional to the Fibonacci sequence.

A golden spiral draws smoothly through the construction.

The figure lands on the upper edge of one of the large squares.

The entire structure begins rotating slowly.

The character looks downward and sees the spiral leading toward the center.

⸻

Scene 10 — The Moving Maze

The geometric construction begins behaving like a living maze.

Squares rotate independently.

Lines extend and retract.

The character runs along one edge, jumps to another, and slides down a vertical segment.

The camera follows the figure through the recursive structure.

The figure becomes smaller as it moves toward the inner squares.

The golden spiral continues glowing and appears to pull the character inward.

⸻

Scene 11 — Recursive Fall

The character reaches a smaller square.

The floor beneath it disappears.

It falls into another nested rectangle.

The same pattern repeats faster:

* land
* run
* jump
* fall into a smaller square

The camera zooms deeper into the construction.

The surrounding lines move outward, creating the illusion that the character is falling endlessly into mathematical recursion.

⸻

Scene 12 — Final Trap

The character lands inside the smallest visible square.

It tries to climb out, but the surrounding lines rise and form a closed geometric cage.

A glowing golden symbol appears above the figure:

\phi

The character looks up at it.

The large wireframe orb briefly appears outside the cage, watching silently.

The orange figure collapses into a tired crouch.

The geometry becomes completely still.

⸻

Final Shot

The camera slowly pulls back.

The entire golden-ratio construction is revealed again.

The tiny orange figure remains trapped at its center.

Text fades in:

Geometry does not chase you.

Then:

It changes the world around you.

The screen fades to black.

A final logo appears:

PROOF MOTION
Nothing in the catalogue fits, so I wrote the scene. Tell me what to change.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        config.frame_width = 9
        config.frame_height = 16

        orange = "#FF8A24"
        cyan = "#55D9FF"
        gold = "#F2C14E"
        white = "#F4F1EA"

        ground = Line(
            [-4.1, -3.25, 0],
            [4.1, -3.25, 0],
            color=GREY_B,
            stroke_width=2,
        )

        head = Circle(
            radius=0.20,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=3,
        ).move_to([-3.1, -1.35, 0])
        body = Line(
            [-3.1, -1.55, 0],
            [-3.1, -2.35, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        arm = Line(
            [-3.1, -1.85, 0],
            [-2.65, -2.08, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        leg1 = Line(
            [-3.1, -2.35, 0],
            [-3.45, -3.25, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        leg2 = Line(
            [-3.1, -2.35, 0],
            [-2.72, -3.25, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=4,
        )
        figure = VGroup(head, body, arm, leg1, leg2)

        figure_label = MathTex(
            r"\varphi",
            color=orange,
            font_size=34,
        ).next_to(head, RIGHT, buff=0.18)

        orb = VGroup(
            Circle(radius=0.95, color=cyan, stroke_width=2),
            Ellipse(width=1.90, height=0.48, color=cyan, stroke_width=2),
            Ellipse(width=0.48, height=1.90, color=cyan, stroke_width=2),
            Line([-0.95, 0, 0], [0.95, 0, 0], color=cyan, stroke_width=1),
        ).move_to([2.25, 2.85, 0])

        particles = VGroup(*[
            Dot(
                [2.25 + 1.2 * np.cos(t), 2.85 + 1.2 * np.sin(t), 0],
                radius=0.04,
                color=gold,
            )
            for t in np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, 9)[:-1]
        ])

        phi = MathTex(
            r"\varphi=1.618\ldots",
            color=gold,
            font_size=30,
        ).move_to([2.25, 0.95, 0])

        ramp = VMobject(
            color=gold,
            stroke_width=3,
        ).set_points_as_corners([
            [-4.0, -2.85, 0],
            [-1.25, -2.85, 0],
            [-0.35, -0.55, 0],
            [-4.0, -2.85, 0],
        ])

        ramp_label = Text(
            "SLOPE",
            font_size=26,
            color=gold,
        ).move_to([-3.05, -2.25, 0])

        opening = VGroup(
            ground,
            figure,
            figure_label,
            orb,
            particles,
            phi,
            ramp,
            ramp_label,
        )

        self.play(Create(opening), run_time=2)
        self.wait(0.4)

        crouch = VGroup(
            Circle(
                radius=0.20,
                color=orange,
                stroke_width=3,
            ).move_to([-2.55, -2.30, 0]),
            Line(
                [-2.55, -2.50, 0],
                [-1.95, -2.82, 0],
                color=orange,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
            Line(
                [-2.3, -2.65, 0],
                [-1.7, -2.85, 0],
                color=orange,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
            Line(
                [-1.95, -2.82, 0],
                [-1.45, -3.25, 0],
                color=orange,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
            Line(
                [-1.95, -2.82, 0],
                [-2.45, -3.25, 0],
                color=orange,
                stroke_width=4,
            ),
        )

        self.play(
            Transform(figure, crouch),
            figure_label.animate.next_to(crouch[0], RIGHT, buff=0.18),
            ramp_label.animate.set_opacity(0.35),
            run_time=1.3,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        squares = VGroup()
        for i, size in enumerate([0.42, 0.68, 1.10, 1.78]):
            squares.add(
                Square(
                    side_length=size,
                    color=gold,
                    stroke_width=2,
                ).move_to([-0.65 + size / 2, -0.55 + size / 2, 0])
            )

        plane = Polygon(
            [-3.7, -0.65, 0],
            [-1.2, 2.0, 0],
            [3.2, 2.0, 0],
            [1.0, -0.65, 0],
            color=gold,
            stroke_width=2,
            fill_opacity=0,
        )

        plane_label = Text(
            "SHAPE CHANGES PATH",
            font_size=25,
            color=white,
        ).move_to([0, -1.15, 0])

        self.play(
            Transform(ramp, plane),
            FadeOut(ramp_label),
            Create(squares),
            FadeIn(plane_label),
            run_time=1.7,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        spiral = VMobject(color=cyan, stroke_width=3)
        spiral_points = []
        for t in np.linspace(0, 2.2 * np.pi, 100):
            radius = 0.05 + 0.06 * t
            spiral_points.append([
                0.45 + radius * np.cos(t),
                0.45 + radius * np.sin(t),
                0,
            ])
        spiral.set_points_smoothly(spiral_points)

        maze = VGroup(*[
            Square(
                side_length=0.75 + 0.28 * i,
                color=cyan,
                stroke_width=2,
            ).move_to([0.45, 0.45, 0])
            for i in range(3)
        ])

        maze_label = Text(
            "RECURSIVE MAP",
            font_size=25,
            color=cyan,
        ).move_to([0.45, 2.15, 0])

        self.play(
            Create(spiral),
            Create(maze),
            FadeIn(maze_label),
            figure.animate.shift([2.0, 1.5, 0]),
            run_time=1.8,
        )
        self.wait(0.3)

        shock = VGroup(*[
            Circle(
                radius=radius,
                color=orange,
                stroke_width=2,
            ).move_to([2.7, -0.7, 0])
            for radius in [0.25, 0.48, 0.72]
        ])

        cage = VGroup(*[
            Line(
                [2.0 + i * 0.35, -2.8, 0],
                [2.0 + i * 0.35, -1.0, 0],
                color=GREY_B,
                stroke_width=2,
            )
            for i in range(5)
        ])
        cage.add(
            Line(
                [1.8, -1.0, 0],
                [3.7, -1.0, 0],
                color=GREY_B,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
            Line(
                [1.8, -2.8, 0],
                [3.7, -2.8, 0],
                color=GREY_B,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
        )

        self.play(
            Create(shock),
            Create(cage),
            maze.animate.rotate(PI / 3),
            figure.animate.shift([0.2, -2.0, 0]).rotate(-PI / 2),
            run_time=1.4,
        )
        self.wait(0.2)

        final = VGroup(
            Text(
                "Geometry does not chase you.",
                font_size=30,
                color=white,
            ),
            Text(
                "It changes the world around you.",
                font_size=30,
                color=white,
            ),
        ).arrange(
            DOWN,
            buff=0.18,
        ).move_to([0, 0.3, 0])

        brand = Text(
            "PROOF MOTION",
            font_size=38,
            color=orange,
        ).move_to([0, -0.8, 0])

        closing = VGroup(final, brand)

        self.play(
            FadeOut(VGroup(
                ground,
                figure,
                figure_label,
                orb,
                particles,
                phi,
                ramp,
                squares,
                plane_label,
                spiral,
                maze,
                maze_label,
                shock,
                cage,
            )),
            FadeIn(closing),
            run_time=1.5,
        )
        self.wait(0.7)

from manim import *

ORANGE = "#F28C28"


def make_figure(x, feet_y, crouch=False, look=0.0):
    head_y = feet_y + (1.35 if crouch else 2.1)
    shoulder_y = feet_y + (0.75 if crouch else 1.25)
    hip_y = feet_y + (0.35 if crouch else 0.65)

    head = Circle(
        radius=0.28,
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    ).move_to([x + 0.10 * look, head_y, 0])

    eye = Dot(
        [x + 0.24 + 0.10 * look, head_y + 0.05, 0],
        radius=0.035,
        color=ORANGE,
    )

    body = Line(
        [x, shoulder_y, 0],
        [x + (0.12 if crouch else 0), hip_y, 0],
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    )

    left_arm = Line(
        [x, shoulder_y, 0],
        [
            x - (0.48 if crouch else 0.42),
            shoulder_y - (0.35 if crouch else 0.55),
            0,
        ],
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    )

    right_arm = Line(
        [x, shoulder_y, 0],
        [
            x + (0.48 + 0.15 * look),
            shoulder_y - (0.25 if crouch else 0.55),
            0,
        ],
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    )

    left_leg = Line(
        [x + 0.10, hip_y, 0],
        [x - (0.42 if crouch else 0.28), feet_y, 0],
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    )

    right_leg = Line(
        [x + 0.10, hip_y, 0],
        [x + (0.46 if crouch else 0.30), feet_y, 0],
        color=ORANGE,
        stroke_width=4,
    )

    return VGroup(
        head,
        eye,
        body,
        left_arm,
        right_arm,
        left_leg,
        right_leg,
    )


class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        ground = Line(
            [-6.4, -2.5, 0],
            [6.4, -2.5, 0],
            color=WHITE,
            stroke_width=2,
        )

        activity = VGroup(
            Dot(
                [4.2, -1.65, 0],
                radius=0.07,
                color=ORANGE,
            ),
            Line(
                [4.2, -1.45, 0],
                [4.2, -1.0, 0],
                color=ORANGE,
                stroke_width=3,
            ),
            Line(
                [3.85, -1.3, 0],
                [4.55, -1.3, 0],
                color=ORANGE,
                stroke_width=3,
            ),
        )

        falling = make_figure(-4.2, 2.0, crouch=False, look=0)
        crouched = make_figure(-1.2, -2.5, crouch=True, look=0)
        upright = make_figure(-1.2, -2.5, crouch=False, look=1)
        upright_center = make_figure(-1.2, -2.5, crouch=False, look=0)

        glow = Circle(
            radius=0.65,
            color=ORANGE,
            fill_color=ORANGE,
            fill_opacity=0.22,
            stroke_width=3,
        ).move_to([-1.2, -2.45, 0])

        self.play(
            AnimationGroup(
                Create(ground),
                FadeIn(activity),
                FadeIn(falling),
                lag_ratio=0.15,
            ),
            run_time=1,
        )

        self.play(
            Transform(falling, crouched),
            run_time=2.2,
            rate_func=smooth,
        )

        self.play(
            GrowFromCenter(glow),
            run_time=0.8,
        )

        self.play(
            Transform(falling, upright),
            FadeOut(glow),
            run_time=1.4,
        )

        self.play(
            Transform(falling, upright_center),
            run_time=1.2,
        )

        self.play(
            AnimationGroup(
                falling.animate.shift(0.05 * UP),
                Rotate(
                    falling[0],
                    0.06,
                    about_point=falling[0].get_center(),
                ),
                Rotate(
                    falling[3],
                    -0.08,
                    about_point=falling[3].get_start(),
                ),
                Rotate(
                    falling[4],
                    0.08,
                    about_point=falling[4].get_start(),
                ),
                lag_ratio=0,
            ),
            run_time=2.4,
            rate_func=there_and_back,
        )

        self.wait(3.0)

from manim import *

class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#090B12"

        orange = "#F28C28"
        white = "#F4F7FF"
        cyan = "#91D9FF"

        center = 2.25 * RIGHT + 0.15 * UP

        points = [
            center + 1.55 * UP,
            center + 1.15 * UP + 0.95 * LEFT,
            center + 0.35 * UP + 1.65 * LEFT,
            center - 0.65 * UP + 1.25 * LEFT,
            center - 1.5 * UP + 0.20 * LEFT,
            center - 1.20 * UP + 0.95 * RIGHT,
            center - 0.25 * UP + 1.62 * RIGHT,
            center + 0.75 * UP + 1.20 * RIGHT,
            center + 0.10 * UP + 0.15 * LEFT,
            center + 0.45 * UP + 0.60 * RIGHT,
            center - 0.35 * UP + 0.60 * LEFT,
            center + 0.90 * UP + 0.15 * RIGHT,
        ]

        edges = [
            (0, 1), (0, 7), (0, 8),
            (1, 2), (1, 8), (1, 10), (1, 6),
            (2, 3), (2, 8), (2, 10), (2, 11), (2, 7),
            (3, 4), (3, 10), (3, 11), (3, 6),
            (4, 5), (4, 10), (4, 11), (4, 9),
            (5, 6), (5, 10), (5, 11),
            (6, 7), (6, 9), (6, 11),
            (7, 8), (7, 9),
            (8, 9), (8, 10), (8, 11),
            (9, 11), (10, 11),
        ]

        wire_lines = VGroup(
            *[
                Line(
                    points[a],
                    points[b],
                    color=cyan,
                    stroke_width=1.2,
                    stroke_opacity=0.58,
                )
                for a, b in edges
            ]
        )

        nodes = VGroup(
            *[Dot(point, radius=0.065, color=white) for point in points]
        )

        orb = VGroup(wire_lines, nodes)

        halo = Circle(
            radius=2.08,
            color=cyan,
            stroke_width=2,
            stroke_opacity=0.16,
        ).move_to(center)

        pulse = Circle(
            radius=2.18,
            color=white,
            stroke_width=1.5,
            stroke_opacity=0.25,
        ).move_to(center)

        particles = VGroup(
            *[
                Dot(
                    center
                    + (1.8 + 0.18 * (index % 3))
                    * np.array(
                        [
                            np.cos(index * 1.7),
                            np.sin(index * 1.7),
                            0,
                        ]
                    ),
                    radius=0.025,
                    color=white,
                    fill_opacity=0.65,
                )
                for index in range(12)
            ]
        )

        head = Circle(
            radius=0.28,
            color=orange,
            fill_color=orange,
            fill_opacity=1,
        ).move_to(5.0 * LEFT + 0.72 * UP)

        body = Line(
            4.78 * LEFT + 0.45 * UP,
            4.45 * LEFT - 0.85 * DOWN,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=8,
        )

        back_arm = Line(
            4.72 * LEFT + 0.25 * UP,
            5.35 * LEFT - 0.05 * UP,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=6,
        )

        front_arm = Line(
            4.65 * LEFT + 0.15 * UP,
            4.05 * LEFT - 0.30 * UP,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=6,
        )

        leg_one = Line(
            4.45 * LEFT - 0.82 * DOWN,
            4.95 * LEFT - 1.55 * DOWN,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=7,
        )

        leg_two = Line(
            4.45 * LEFT - 0.82 * DOWN,
            4.05 * LEFT - 1.55 * DOWN,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=7,
        )

        eye = Dot(
            5.10 * LEFT + 0.80 * UP,
            radius=0.035,
            color=BLACK,
        )

        character = VGroup(
            head,
            body,
            back_arm,
            front_arm,
            leg_one,
            leg_two,
            eye,
        )

        label = Text(
            "UNKNOWN FORM",
            font_size=24,

from manim import *
import numpy as np


class GeneratedScene(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#090B16"

        orange = "#FF8A3D"
        cyan = "#62E6FF"
        gold = "#FFD166"
        white = "#F4F1DE"

        title = Text("A WORLD THAT BENDS", font_size=46, color=white)
        subtitle = Text(
            "geometry in motion",
            font_size=28,
            color=cyan,
        ).next_to(title, DOWN, buff=0.3)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(title),
            FadeIn(subtitle),
            run_time=1.0,
        )

        head = Circle(
            radius=0.18,
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=5,
        ).move_to([-5.2, -0.2, 0])

        body = Line(
            [-5.2, -0.4, 0],
            [-5.2, -1.25, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=5,
        )

        arm1 = Line(
            [-5.2, -0.65, 0],
            [-4.78, -0.92, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=5,
        )

        arm2 = Line(
            [-5.2, -0.65, 0],
            [-5.58, -0.88, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=5,
        )

        leg1 = Line(
            [-5.2, -1.25, 0],
            [-4.82, -1.72, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=5,
        )

        leg2 = Line(
            [-5.2, -1.25, 0],
            [-5.56, -1.72, 0],
            color=orange,
            stroke_width=5,
        )

        figure = VGroup(
            head,
            body,
            arm1,
            arm2,
            leg1,
            leg2,
        )

        figure_label = Text(
            "traveler",
            font_size=24,
            color=orange,
        ).next_to(figure, UP, buff=0.15)

        orb = VGroup(
            Circle(
                radius=1.35,
                color=cyan,
                stroke_width=3,
            ),
            Circle(
                radius=0.75,
                color=cyan,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
            Line(
                LEFT * 1.35,
                RIGHT * 1.35,
                color=cyan,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
            Line(
                UP * 1.35,
                DOWN * 1.35,
                color=cyan,
                stroke_width=2,
            ),
        ).move_to([1.0, 0.25, 0])

        orb_label = Text(
            "orb",
            font_size=26,
            color=cyan,
        ).next_to(orb, UP, buff=0.15)

        phi = Text(
            "phi",
            font_size=34,
            color=gold,
        ).next_to(orb, RIGHT, buff=0.2)

        self.play(
            FadeOut(title),
            FadeOut(subtitle),
            Create(figure),
            FadeIn(figure_label),
            Create(orb),
            FadeIn(orb_label),
            run_time=1.5,
        )

        ground = VMobject(
            color=white,
            stroke_width=4,
        ).set_points_as_corners(
            [
                [-6, -2, 0],
                [-2, -2, 0],
                [1, -2, 0],
                [6, -2, 0],
            ]
        )

        ramp = VMobject(
            color=gold,
            stroke_width=5,
        ).set_points_as_corners(
            [
                [-6, -2, 0],
                [-1, -2, 0],
                [2, -0.2, 0],
                [6, 1.5, 0],
            ]
        )

        ramp_label = Text(
            "the ground changes",
            font_size=26,
            color=gold,
        ).move_to([3.7, -1.5, 0])

        trail = TracedPath(
            figure.get_center,
            stroke_color=orange,
            stroke_width=3,
        )

        self.add(trail)

        self.play(
            figure.animate.shift(RIGHT * 3.2),
            orb.animate.rotate(PI / 2),
            FadeIn(phi),
            figure.animate.shift(RIGHT * 2.0),
            orb.animate.shift(RIGHT * 1.8),
            FadeOut(phi),
            Create(ground),
            run_time=1.5,
        )

        self.play(
            Transform(ground, ramp),
            FadeIn(ramp_label),
            figure.animate.shift(RIGHT * 1.0 + UP * 1.6),
            figure_label.animate.shift(RIGHT * 6.2 + UP * 1.6),
            run_time=1.3,
        )

        rect = VGroup(
            Square(
                side_length=1.0,
                color=gold,
            ),
            Square(
                side_length=1.6,
                color=gold,
            ),
            Square(
                side_length=2.6,
                color=gold,
            ),
        ).arrange(
            RIGHT,
            buff=0.15,
        ).move_to([-3.4, 1.0, 0])

        rect_label = Text(
            "Fibonacci world",
            font_size=28,
            color=gold,
        ).next_to(rect, DOWN, buff=0.2)

        spiral = ParametricFunction(
            lambda t: np.array(
                [
                    -0.8 + 0.11 * t * np.cos(t),
                    1.0 + 0.11 * t * np.sin(t),
                    0,
                ]
            ),
            t_range=[0, 5 * PI],
            color=cyan,
            stroke_width=4,
        )

        maze = VGroup(
            *[
                Square(
                    side_length=1.0 + 0.38 * i,
                    color=cyan,
                    stroke_width=2,
                )
                for i in range(4)
            ]
        ).move_to([2.8, 0.7, 0])

        maze_label = Text(
            "recursive path",
            font_size=26,
            color=cyan,
        ).move_to([3.9, 2.7, 0])

        self.play(
            FadeOut(ramp_label),
            FadeOut(trail),
            FadeIn(rect),
            FadeIn(rect_label),
            Create(spiral),
            FadeIn(maze),
            FadeIn(maze_label),
            figure.animate.shift(LEFT * 5 + DOWN * 1.2),
            FadeOut(figure_label),
            run_time=1.8,
        )

        cage = VGroup(
            *[
                Square(
                    side_length=1.2 + 0.55 * i,
                    color=orange if i % 2 == 0 else cyan,
                    stroke_width=3,
                )
                for i in range(5)
            ]
        ).move_to([0, -0.1, 0])

        closing = Text(
            "Geometry does not chase you.",
            font_size=34,
            color=white,
        ).to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        closing2 = Text(
            "It changes the world around you.",
            font_size=34,
            color=gold,
        ).next_to(closing, DOWN, buff=0.18)

        self.play(
            FadeOut(rect),
            FadeOut(rect_label),
            FadeOut(spiral),
            FadeOut(maze),
            FadeOut(maze_label),
            FadeOut(figure),
            FadeIn(cage),
            cage.animate.scale(0.55),
            FadeIn(closing),
            FadeIn(closing2),
            run_time=2.0,
        )

        self.wait(0.4)
